purpose: Prospectively freeze catastrophic-collapse, parameter-match, and compute-budget gates before successor held-out treatment outcomes are available.
claim_boundary: Passing these gates establishes only that the preregistered control-plane constraints were met. It does not establish representation quality, mechanism validity, accuracy benefit, significance, external validation, or scientific success.

design_rationale.collapse_thresholds: Operational catastrophic-collapse guards chosen prospectively and conservatively. They are not represented as literature-derived universal representation-quality thresholds.
design_rationale.parameter_tolerance: Gradient-active parameter matching is the primary comparability quantity. Stop-gradient EMA target parameters are reported separately rather than hidden from accounting.
design_rationale.compute_ratio: The treatment may incur bounded auxiliary-objective overhead, but label exposure, optimizer steps, search budget, device class, and precision must remain matched. Accelerator-time overhead is capped prospectively.

collapse_thresholds.interpretation: These are catastrophic-collapse falsifiers only. Clearing them must not be described as proving healthy, useful, disentangled, or non-collapsed representations in a stronger sense.
collapse_thresholds.secondary_system_boundary: T2 and VQ variants cannot rescue a T1 collapse-gate failure. Their diagnostics are reported separately if those secondary systems are ever authorized.

decision_integration.h3_noncollapse_requires: all collapse_thresholds pass for every retained T1 primary seed

stacked_resolution_boundary.reason: This branch is stacked on active PR 167 and does not rewrite the parent branch concurrently. Canonical blocker-ledger reconciliation is a later integration step after this artifact receives review.
